messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to roll the 'stepdown' autoscale change to the reserved-gpu pools tonight 23:00 UTC. It's a small config tweak (reduce minBurst for tiny pools). Need smoke owners + rollback owner.
kevin: I'm available, I can own rollback and watch metrics. What's the canary target and timing?
maya: Canary = 5% traffic to aurora pool for 15m, then evaluate p95/p99 and eviction rate. Sequence: deploy policy, route canary, run smoke, evaluate, roll forward or rollback.
aj: quick note from the dry-run: eviction spikes can appear for <5m then settle. We should use both eviction_rate and actual OOMs as abort signals.
simon: Suggest smoke steps: small synthetic load hitting /v1/generate for a few seq lengths. Check console p95, packet drops, and node GPU memory. Example load command below:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.internal/redwood/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-4r","input":"hello"}' & done
```
deploy-bot: CI ✅ for change #3739 (policy: stepdown-2026-03). All tests passed.
sre-oncall: I'll monitor infra alerts and ASG metrics. Abort conditions I care about: sustained eviction_rate > 2/min AND p95 > baseline + 80ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
kevin: Rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-pool-rollback — rollback will reapply previous policy and drain canary slice. I'll be primary for executing.
maya: Plan timeline: 22:50 UTC — final checks, 23:00 — apply policy to control plane, 23:05 — route 5% canary, 23:20 — decision window, 23:25 — roll forward to 100% if green. Ping @kevin 10m prior.
aj: thumbs-up. Also set the orchestration timeout to 10m so we don't get stuck mid-canary.
simon: Adding quick commands for smoke verification:
- Check latency: `curl -s https://console.internal/pools/aurora/metrics | jq .p95`
- Eviction rate: `curl -s https://console.internal/pools/aurora/evictions`
- GPU mem: `kubectl top pod -n inference | grep aurora`
kevin: I'll be on-call at 23:00 and will execute rollback if we see the abort signals. Please @mention me when canary starts. :thumbsup:
maya: I'll kick it off and post status in this thread. If anyone wants to run preflight checks earlier, ping me.
kevin: lgtm.
sre-oncall: I'll set an automation to page on the eviction metric and tie a short runbook to that alert.
maya: thanks all — will post the canary start timestamp and short status updates here.
